description: This Java class 'AuthController' is a REST controller providing authentication endpoints for login and token refresh, using Spring Boot annotations and dependencies.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller managing authentication-related API endpoints for login and token refresh.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login requests, authenticates via AuthService, and returns access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles token refresh requests, calls AuthService to generate a new access token.
